div.h1: PR #5 - HUD: follows the world scale, never knows Game
div.p: Hud draws a bar with the score and lives on top of the world. main.ts feeds it plain numbers, so Game holds no reference to Hud.

g.text: STARTUP (once): font first, then Hud, then stage order
RUNTIME: Hud follows the world and reads plain values, Game never calls it

text.tspan: RULE: Text in PIXI is a bitmap rendered once.
The font must be loaded before the first Text exists,
and text.text is assigned only on change.
bar: full world width x barHeight
score: anchor (1, 0.5), gap/2 left of centre
lives: anchor (0, 0.5), gap/2 right of centre
exposes score and lives as getters
